description: Cross-language conformance cases. Each case runs the real Claude or Codex runtime in both packages: offline against a local mock API that answers with `mock` steps and records requests, and live (opt-in, billed) when the case has a `live` section. Format: docs/fixtures/CONFORMANCE.md.

typescript.anthropic:systemPrompt: Claude takes it as options.systemPrompt; codex.system_prompt covers the reserved top-level name
typescript.anthropic:maxTurns: Claude takes it as options.maxTurns; codex.max_turns covers the reserved top-level name
typescript.anthropic:permissionMode: Claude takes it as options.permissionMode; codex.permission_mode covers the reserved top-level name
typescript.anthropic:builtinTools: Claude takes it as options.tools; codex.builtin_tools covers the reserved top-level name
typescript.anthropic:timeout: Python's timeout maps to signal; TypeScript reserves the name
typescript.codex:timeout: Python's timeout maps to signal; TypeScript reserves the name
typescript.codex:client.baseUrl: Selects the built-in provider, whose websocket transport and retries the mock cannot turn off; cases select a custom provider in CODEX_HOME/config.toml
typescript.codex:client.codexPathOverride: Runtime location; codex-exec.test.ts drives a fake runtime through it
typescript.codex:thread.skipGitRepoCheck: The runner sets it for every case because scratch directories are not repositories
typescript.codex:thread.additionalDirectories: No Python counterpart; it only adds writable sandbox roots
